statement: GEOMETRY VALIDATION FIXTURE — NOT A REAL BOTTLE COMPARISON

presentation_mode.rule: validation renders are never re-badged as presentation (§1 two-mode principle); geometry verdicts come only from mode A

dispositions.observation: Clay renders show a consistent silhouette across front, side, three_quarter, wireframe and normals: straight-walled cylindrical body with a slight radius at the base edge, a short tapered shoulder, a narrow neck, a squat cylindrical collar and a domed dropper bulb. The form is internally self-consistent and free of visible profile breaks, but with no authoritative real-bottle outline in the package the silhouette cannot be compared to the real container, so no difference can be confirmed or excluded.
dispositions.missing_evidence: No real-bottle reference image is packaged (references_packaged: 0); reference_availability is only PARTIAL (owner measurements + uncalibrated photos, none included in the sheet). A calibrated, camera-matched reference silhouette or overlay/difference plate would be required.

dispositions.observation: The shoulder reads as a short, fairly tight convex transition from the body wall into the neck, visible in front, side, three_quarter and the closure_detail crop; the normals pass shows a smooth gradient across the transition with no faceting or shading discontinuity. Whether this radius and transition height match the real bottle cannot be assessed without a reference.
dispositions.missing_evidence: A dimensioned or camera-matched reference of the real bottle's shoulder radius/transition height; none is packaged.

dispositions.observation: The neck is a short straight cylinder between the shoulder and the collar, largely occluded by the collar in front and side views; the closure_detail crop exposes only its lower portion. No thread or finish detail is modelled. Correspondence to the real bottle's neck cannot be evaluated from the supplied evidence.
dispositions.missing_evidence: Reference imagery or neck/finish dimensions (neck diameter, neck length, finish detail) for the real bottle; the package supplies only overall contract H/W/D.

dispositions.observation: The closure is modelled as a plain cylindrical collar with softly rounded top/bottom edges and a domed capsule bulb above it; no knurling, thread line, or crimp seam is present. The dedicated closure_detail view is off-centre with its bounds touching the frame (x0 115–x1 1217, y0 432–y1 2199) so part of the closure/shoulder context is cropped, further limiting inspection. No reference exists against which to judge closure differences.
dispositions.missing_evidence: A real-bottle closure reference (dropper collar height/diameter, bulb profile) and a correctly framed closure_detail view; the packaged closure_detail is flagged RENDER_OFF_CENTER, touches the frame, and reports closure_view_coverage 0.5532.

dispositions.observation: Against the internal contract (H 114.3 · W 37.4 · D 37.4) the rendered numbers are close but not identical: front and side rendered_extent 37.36 mm vs contract 37.40 mm (-0.04 mm), front rendered_height 113.64 mm and side rendered_height 114.23 mm — a 0.59 mm (~10 px) discrepancy between two orthographic views of a nominally square-section body, and both short of the 114.3 mm contract height. This is an internal render/measurement inconsistency worth owner attention, but proportional fidelity to the real bottle itself remains undeterminable without reference evidence.
dispositions.missing_evidence: An authoritative real-bottle proportion reference (calibrated photograph or full dimensional set beyond overall H/W/D) to compare body:neck:closure ratios.

dispositions.observation: Front, side, top and bounds_dimensions views appear to share one consistent near-orthographic camera preset (identical x-bounds 479–1120 for front and side); the three_quarter diagnostic reads as a plausible rotation of the same setup. The closure_detail view is flagged RENDER_OFF_CENTER and its bounds touch the frame, so its framing deviates from the other views. Camera agreement with any real-bottle photograph cannot be tested with the supplied material.
dispositions.missing_evidence: A reference photograph with known/recoverable camera parameters to compare against real_bottle_camera_standard/1.0; the packaged photos are described as uncalibrated and none are included.

dispositions.observation: No artwork, label, decoration or print of any kind is applied anywhere on the clay geometry in any of the eight views; surfaces are uniformly blank, which is expected for a neutral geometry validation render. There is therefore nothing to place or mis-place.

No brand mark, embossed logo or engraved identifier is present on the body, shoulder, collar or base in front, side, three_quarter, closure_detail, wireframe or normals views. Logo placement is not carried by this geometry fixture.

No product typography exists on the geometry. The only type is sheet/annotation typography: the header block, panel captions and §11 measurement restatement are crisp and legible, but the annotation text baked into the bounds_dimensions tile (the red 'GEOMETRY VALIDATION FIXTURE' line and the 'contract: H 114.3mm · W 37.4mm · D 37.4mm' line) renders at a very small size and is effectively sub-legible at contact-sheet scale; it is only readable because the §11 block restates it verbatim. Cosmetic annotation-legibility issue only, no bearing on geometry.

Out of scope by rule for this mode. The surfaces are the expected uniform neutral matte clay with no glass, transparency, refraction or label material simulated; this is the intended validation shader and is not assessed for realism.

Lighting appears consistent with the declared real_bottle_lighting_standard/1.0 across all beauty views: soft, even, largely shadowless illumination with a gentle vertical falloff. No blown highlights, no clipped blacks, no visible noise or fireflies at 64 samples, and no light leaks. Subject-to-background separation is low-contrast (light clay on light grey) but silhouette edges remain readable in every view, and the wireframe/normals diagnostics provide independent edge confirmation.

The renders carry no colour intent — a single neutral off-white clay across all geometry, with the normals pass using conventional false colour for diagnostics. Colour is out of scope for this neutral-clay mode, and in any case no calibrated reference exists, so any colour difference from the real bottle cannot be resolved.
dispositions.missing_evidence: A colour-calibrated real-bottle reference (with known illuminant/white balance); the package contains zero reference images and describes the available photos as uncalibrated.

dispositions.observation: Out of scope by rule. The package explicitly declares client_presentation_mode ABSENT_BLOCKED (RBV2C_PRESENTATION_RENDERER_NOT_BUILT, OWNER_GATE_PILOT_GEOMETRY_INSPECTION_PENDING) and the sheet restates the §1 two-mode principle that validation renders are never re-badged as presentation. These clay renders were not judged as, and must not be reused as, client-facing imagery.

dispositions.category: uncertainty caused by missing reference evidence
dispositions.observation: The sheet states reference availability PARTIAL (owner measurements + uncalibrated photos) yet references_packaged is 0 — no real-bottle image, overlay or difference plate appears anywhere in the eight tiles. Consequently six difference-defined categories (silhouette, shoulder, neck, closure, aspect/proportion, perspective, plus colour) are structurally undischargeable from this package and are reported as uncertain rather than clear. This compounds with the declared package state: subject is the FROZEN P1 V4 regression fixture with P1_OWNER_VISUAL_APPROVAL NOT_GRANTED and a standing uncertainty 'V3 provisional geometry — owner review pending', and with the open RENDER_OFF_CENTER:closure_detail warning plus the front/side rendered-height mismatch (113.64 vs 114.23 mm against a 114.3 mm contract). Evidence for owner consideration only.
